description: PreToolUse opens the dispatcher only for Bash, apply_patch and the sub-agent spawn tool (hook name ending in spawn_agent), looks for the dispatcher from the session folder up to the nearest folder holding .git, and blocks the call when no Python interpreter runs the dispatcher or the dispatcher is missing or exits abnormally; every other hook event keeps one universal matcher into the manifest-shipped dispatcher .codex/pm_orch_codex.py --hook-dispatch, which decides in process which registered guards run for the payload. SubagentStart records matcher drift but never denies. Compaction hooks create a deduplicated checkpoint skeleton and re-inject the engine-owned PM snapshot without blocking compaction. Execpolicy remains argv-only and cannot enforce spawn metadata.
